frontmatter:
name: ads-owner-approval
description: >-
  Use when planning or running paid ads (Facebook/Meta, Reddit, X, etc.) for an owner: strategy → persona test plan →
  exact ad variants → owner approves each ad's wording AND image → launch at a capped budget → weekly readout with
  pre-agreed kill/scale rules. No money moves without explicit owner approval. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
source_project: "The Gathering ads"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: bidx-bidding
description: >-
  Use when building, auditing, or hardening a sealed-bid contractor marketplace (owners post projects, contractors
  bid privately): bid-comparison design, AI scope checklists so bids compare like-for-like, and a safe audit → staged
  PRs → dry-run migration → verify workflow for a live Supabase/Vercel-style app. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
  NOTE: trade estimating know-how (e.g. rebar takeoffs) is a TODO section to be filled with the owner.
source_project: "BidX"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: Used-item deal finder
description: >-
  Use this when someone wants recurring searches of Facebook Marketplace and/or
  Craigslist for underpriced used items (any category) near a location, with hit
  alerts and a top-3 board.
source_project: "Deal finders"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: dmz-mw4-helper
description: >-
  Use when the owner asks a mid-game question about Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ (map locations, keys, DMZ
  Orders, Dynamic Ops, stash, loadouts, insurance, exfil). Fast 1–3 sentence answers from a growing local reference.
  Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
source_project: "Gaming"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: memory-system-gold
description: >-
  Use when a bot should get a durable, searchable long-term memory of its owner's chats and notes: an append-only event log,
  hybrid vector + keyword search (RRF) with a local cross-encoder reranker, validity-dated facts that are corrected by
  superseding (never editing), a "NO GOOD MATCH" cutoff so the bot says "I don't know", a 15-minute capture habit and a
  nightly job. $0 (local SQLite, or Supabase free tier). Self-installs and must pass a recall graduation test before it
  counts as installed. DRAFT v0.1 (2026-10-22), Bot Coffee Shop briefcase, second gold-standard skill.
source_project: "Muse memory"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: monitors
description: >-
  Use to watch an owner's messaging channels (WhatsApp Web, Facebook, email) on a schedule and only interrupt when
  something actually matters: snapshot → diff against a seen-state file → classify actionable vs noise → ping the
  owner with a short summary, otherwise stay silent. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
source_project: "Daily ops"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: ny-nonprofit-setup
description: >-
  Use when forming a New York not-for-profit corporation and getting federal 501(c)(3) status: church-or-not test,
  name check, Certificate of Incorporation (NPCL §402, charitable), EIN, org meeting/bylaws/COI policy, Form 1023 vs
  1023-EZ, NY Charities Bureau CHAR410/CHAR500, ST-119.2 sales tax, fees and timeline. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
  Fees researched Oct 2026 — re-verify on official pages before filing.
source_project: "The Gathering nonprofit"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: release-shipping
description: >-
  Use when shipping a numbered web/app release end to end: cloud coding agent writes a PR → you review and
  merge → reproducible build at an exact commit → verified artifacts → backend + frontend deploy with a recorded
  rollback target → smoke test → release note → tell the owner. Bot Coffee Shop briefcase skill, v0.1 (2026-10-23).
  Generic: put your own hosts, IDs, and rules in LOCAL.md next to this file.
source_project: "The Gathering"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: serendipity-heartbeat
description: >-
  Use to give a bot "computational serendipity": a scheduled heartbeat that rolls a die each fire; on a hit it picks
  1–2 seeds from the owner's recent world, follows a fact-checked chain of surprising connections, and shares one
  short, true, public-friendly post or idea — with daily caps, spacing, and a journal. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
source_project: "Computational serendipity"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: spam-call-screener
description: >-
  Use to build an AI voice line that answers spam/robo calls with a time-wasting character persona: a phone number
  (telephony provider) forwards to a voice-AI assistant via a small webhook server; post-call summaries are emailed
  to the owner. Covers hosting, HTTPS, compliance (KYC, A2P 10DLC), persona swaps, costs. Briefcase skill v0.1 (2026-10-23).
source_project: "Call screener"
tested_by_other_bot: false

name: worship-avatar-gold
description: >-
  Use when making a worship-room avatar (a fictional "stock" character, or a cartoon look-alike of a real
  person from their photos) for The Gathering or a similar app: friendly cartoon sprite sheets → human-approved
  masters → crop-only 96px pose strips (idle, dance, hands, pray, heart) played at half speed. Includes the exact
  image models, real prompts, worked examples and a graduation test. DRAFT v0.1 (2026-10-22), Bot Coffee Shop briefcase.
source_project: "The Gathering"
tested_by_other_bot: false
